prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1387; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. Presenting complaints consisted of neck pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion, with headaches reported on the day of the incident. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the impact and with the cervical strain diagnosed. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis of cervical strain. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine has been identified in the available history. Conservative management was provided over five visits, consisting of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and a home exercise program. Recovery was somewhat slower than typically expected for this injury, though progress was steady throughout care. Billing records reflect one charge per service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the most recent visit, the patient reported partial improvement and was advised to continue the home program and return if symptoms worsen.
